scene: Across the bridge, a bustling multi-level transit deck awaits.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide wooden transit deck along a single ground line. On the far left sits a waiting glass-roofed trolley. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands just left of centre. In the centre rises an open spiral lift with bronze gates. A moored river barge waits on the far right.
